rationale: Rick and Ivan both operate at the intersection of AI and business systems, with complementary expertise: Rick has built a global talent platform using AI/ML to match opportunity at scale, while Ivan is architecting multi-agent AI systems to automate revenue generation for service businesses. Rick's conviction that AI/ML will be central to matching talent with opportunity, combined with his Techstars mentorship background, pairs well with Ivan's need to connect with frontier AI builders—and Ivan's 4 successful agency exits and systems-thinking approach could inform how Pangian scales its talent marketplace.
intro_message: Rick Uzcategui, meet Ivan Ivanka — you're both San Francisco-based founders betting on AI as the lever for scaling human systems (talent matching vs. revenue automation), and Ivan's actively looking to connect with builders at the frontier of applied AI.
